gate2TierAccuracy.note: Development figures are in-sample diagnostics only. They are not held-out gate results, and blocked tiers are not treated as failures.

gate3CityRanking.reason: The development panel lacks complete independent truth for the 19-tier daily basket: street food has no direct daily-tier truth, all five drink tiers are blocked, and BudgetYourTrip mid/high activities are circular.

gate4CostBandAgreement.reason: A complete independent product-level cost-band truth is not available for the development cities; the frozen manifest band cannot be treated as an independent full-basket observation.

gate5TripLevelRealism.reason: Trip totals require an independent full daily basket, but drinks and two activity tiers remain blocked and street food has no direct daily-tier truth.

gate6NoRegressionVsV1.reason: The available development truth does not cover all 19 product tiers, so no all-tier comparison against v1 can be made without turning partial evidence into a gate result.
